Australasian Grebe, Tachybaptus novaehollandiae, Australian Hobby, Falco longipennis

≠===============≠ The Hobby has a serious speed advantage if it comes in from a stoop. As a relative to Peregrine, they have a top speed in a stoop that must be more than 150kph. But the little Grebe has a degree of flexibilty. The Hobby has managed to grasp a clawful of tail feathers.

The pursuit is on.

title: File:Bonelli's Eagle at Osman Sagar, Hyderabad (49497461872).jpg
description:
Known to be a ferocious bird, it is a medium sized bird of prey sighted hunting many different kinds of other birds and even smaller mammals.

I found it chasing away a Peregrine Falcon who was flying at full speed to get away from this large bird. After it drove out the Falcon from the hunting area, it surveyed for a couple of minutes and entirely disappeared from sight. I was lucky to get this shot when it stooped a bit low.
